name: Durian
description: A comprehensive benchmark for evaluating structure-based 3D molecular generation models, providing datasets and evaluation protocols.
reputation: Well-regarded among researchers working on structure-based molecular generation and used as a reference dataset/protocol in specialized computational-chemistry studies.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on 3D molecular structures; evaluation depends heavily on chosen metrics (validity, novelty, RMSD, docking scores); results sensitive to scoring functions and dataset biases; requires chemistry expertise to interpret.
